hints.title: Bounded Distinct Divisors
hints.text: For any fixed right endpoint, extending a subarray leftward produces at most log2(max(nums)) distinct greatest common divisors.

hints.title: Earliest Index Merging
hints.text: Maintain a list of (leftmost_index, gcd_val) ending at index i. When two prefixes share the same gcd, keep the smaller index to maximize subarray sum.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Multiplication
hints.text: Query subarray sums in O(1) via prefix sums and update maximum score when length r - l + 1 is at least k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintaining logarithmic distinct prefix gcd states with prefix sum queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subarrays takes O(n^2 log M) which times out for n = 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Compress contiguous subarrays by greatest common divisor states.
